title: Empirical Study of Pop and Jazz Mix Ratios for Genre-Adaptive Chord Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.04998v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper treats chord progression generation as a standalone task and asks how much old-domain data must be retained in fine-tuning to acquire a new genre without forgetting the old. I study jazz fine-tuning of a pop-pretrained 25M-parameter Music Transformer (84.21% top-1 next-token accuracy on a held-out pop test set). The jazz corpus is over two orders of magnitude smaller than the pop corpus, so every run uses all 1,513 jazz training sequences, and the swept variable is the volume of pop "rehearsal" data mixed alongside: 0, 1K, 2.5K, 5K, or 10K. At the tabulated best epochs every fine-tuned run gains 7 to 9 points of jazz top-1 (the released F1 checkpoint equals the Phase 0 baseline, as the paper's Correction explains), and pop top-1 falls by 2.11 points under jazz-only fine-tuning but by at most 1.19 with rehearsal. translated_title: 针对风格自适应和弦生成的流行与爵士数据混合比例实证研究
translated_abstract: 本文将和弦进行生成视为一项独立任务，探讨在微调过程中需要保留多少旧领域数据，才能在习得新风格的同时不遗忘旧风格。作者对一个以流行音乐预训练的2500万参数Music Transformer（在留出的流行测试集上top-1下一token准确率为84.21%）进行爵士乐微调研究。由于爵士语料库比流行语料库小两个数量级以上，每次实验均使用全部1,513条爵士训练序列，而所扫描的变量是与其混合的流行“排练”数据量：0、1K、2.5K、5K或10K。在表中所列的最佳epoch处，每个微调后的模型在爵士top-1上提升了7至9个百分点（发布的F1检查点与Phase 0基线持平，如论文的更正说明所解释）；在仅用爵士数据微调时，流行top-1下降了2.11个百分点，而使用排练数据时下降幅度最多为1.19个百分点。Top-1指标还会对每个序列的三个头部token进行评分，其中两个token会改变整个运行结果：jazz-maj……
tldr: 本研究通过对流行预训练Music Transformer进行爵士微调并系统扫描混合的流行“排练”数据量，实证发现排练数据可将爵士top-1提升7至9个百分点，同时将流行风格的遗忘从2.11个百分点降至最多1.19个百分点，为小数据新风格的适应提供了混合比例依据。
en_tdlr: This empirical study sweeps pop "rehearsal" data volumes (0–10K) mixed into jazz fine-tuning of a pop-pretrained Music Transformer, showing rehearsal data yields 7–9 points of jazz top-1 gains while limiting pop forgetting to at most 1.19 points (versus 2.11 with jazz-only fine-tuning).
